summary: Candidate D v4 passes the forty-four-target artifact-removal task, preserves the mark_26 tree and all protected map features, and has no visible seam. It remains below the golden threshold because the eastern mountains have fine symbols but no readable broad relief hierarchy.
required_changes: Change only the mountain relief substrate: introduce broad, irregular, low-contrast plan-view tonal massifs and slope-density gradients while preserving all existing rocks, trees, roads, fields, cities, repaired targets, and protected geography.
